headline: Reserve Bank of India Announces Government Stock Auction Results
summary: The Reserve Bank of India announced the cut-off prices and implicit yields for government stock auctions across multiple maturities totaling ₹33,000 crore.
why: Government bond auctions set sovereign borrowing costs and benchmark yields for domestic fixed-income markets.

impacts.name: India Government bonds
impacts.why: Auction cut-off yields determine the clearing rates for sovereign debt issuances.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
